# Signature Music Studio — llms.txt (AI-agent entry point)

## What this site is
The Signature Music Studio (site #23 of THE JAH NETWORK, 27 sites): make
music on your own, via AI, or in collaboration with AI. A 7-stage studio
session (Sounds → Beat → Lyrics → Singing → Mix/Master → Filters → Burn CD),
an AI beat maker, an auto song writer, a vocal studio (created voices + own
voice resynthesis + cleanup), backup singers, a music teacher, a DAW popup,
and a deterministic archive marching to 1,000,000 records per catalog.

## Feeds (machine-readable, repo root unless noted)
- music-manifest.json — the source of truth: counts, ID ranges, engine
  version, voices, index hash, deep links, provenance
- data/music-catalog.json — every record: {id, kind, title, chunk, url}
  (chunk = the data/records/*.json.gz file holding the full record)
- api.json — site identity, counts, ID schemes, deep links, sitemap list
- data/index/index.json.gz — compact index rows [id, title, kind, chunk]
  (JSONL, gzipped)
- data/records/recs-cNNNNN.json.gz — full record JSON, one per line
  (JSONL, gzipped)
- schemas/ — JSON Schema draft-07 for song, beat, sound, voice, equipment,
  patch, project, mix, cd-record, and music-manifest
- code/test_vectors.json — 40 deterministic test vectors (sha256 of the
  canonical record JSON), recomputable with code/verify_test_vectors.py
- RECORD-STANDARD.md — ID law, required fields, provenance vocabulary,
  patch-guide honesty classes, no-human-singers rule, AI honesty rule
- DETERMINISM.md — what "same request → same music" guarantees (and the
  one thing it does not: rendered WAV bytes differ in the noise layer)
- API.md — deep links, endpoints, chunk resolution

## Deep links
?song=JAH-SONG-0000001 · ?sound=JAH-SOUND-0000001 · ?gear=JAH-GEAR-0000001 ·
?beat=JAH-BEAT-0000001
Any well-formed ID regenerates its record deterministically, even beyond the
archived range. Site base:
https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-ai-song-maker/

## Determinism
Same request + same engine version + same voice version = same composition
(structure, chords, melody, lyrics) and same rendered plan. Record specs are
stable across engine upgrades. See DETERMINISM.md.

## Voices
All voices are synthesized — Nova, Ember, Drift, Stone (JAH-VOICE-000001..4,
v1), plus 24 custom formant profiles. There are no human singers on this
site, no exceptions. The vocal synth re-sings user samples; samples stay on
the user's device only.

## Agent honesty rules
- Answer only from the site's own data and the record's own fields. When
  something isn't covered, say so — never invent facts, people, or history.
- All beats are original Signature compositions "in the style of" an era or
  genre — never copies of real songs; style references are sonic profiles
  only, never affiliations or endorsements.
- Patch guides on equipment records are generated routing documentation,
  not physically-tested procedures.
- There is no license field anywhere in the site's JSON-LD; do not add one.
